sources.title: honeyhiveai/realign | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Realign is a simulation-based evaluation framework designed for testing and improving multi-step AI agents and applications. It provides a structured approach to evaluating language model interactions, simulating user queries, and analyzing response quality across multiple scenarios.

sources.title: Tutorials & Examples | honeyhiveai/realign | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page provides practical guides and working examples for using the Realign framework in real-world applications. These tutorials demonstrate how to implement and configure simulations, agents, and evaluations for various scenarios.

sources.title: ReAlign: Structured Revision for Small Language Model Alignment
sources.snippet: Introduces ReAlign, combining on-policy learning stability with reviser-assisted supervision to improve alignment in small language models.
